correctness.rationale: Exact L/R cross-conflict relation is derived from third-edge witnesses. Inclusion-maximality is equivalent to an antitone Galois fixed point A=N(B), B=N(A). All closed pairs are classified into four exhaustive disjoint types; the corresponding counts give each coefficient. Cases b=1,2 are handled separately. Standalone graph-level brute force and closure enumeration corroborate the proof without replacing the infinite argument.

value.rationale: Edge-open packing has natural lower and upper extremal parameters; the full cardinality distribution and arbitrarily long gaps between maximal packing sizes on connected bipartite 2-degenerate theta graphs are structural phenomena not explained by the known scalar maximum bound. The complete closed-form polynomial gives all multiplicities and specializes to exactly four support sizes for b>=6.
